text: Yes. The tunnel is part of the app, which builds with compileSdk and targetSdk 36 (Android 16), the same as everything else. The phone side of it shipped in v0.114.17. It is a plain read-only HTTP stream, so no Android-version-specific API is involved. The tunnel itself runs on the GitHub runner (a free Cloudflare quick tunnel), not on your phone. The phone connects to it for the 2-second status and falls back to GitHub polling when the tunnel isn't there. The engine resumed at 08:00 ET and I saw the tunnel come up.
